steps.name: Data notice
steps.goal: If Your data and AI providers is visible, tap the Agree and continue button at the bottom. Otherwise only wait for the session list.
steps.done: The data notice is gone and the session list shows.

steps.name: Updates pill on the phone
steps.goal: If the api-gateway folder is not selected, tap the api-gateway folder pill at the top of the list. Otherwise only wait. Do not tap any element labelled add.
steps.done: The list shows the api-gateway sessions and the updates pill floats above the composer.

steps.name: Updates drawer opens as one list
steps.goal: Tap the updates pill (labelled ... updates from auto agents. Open).
steps.done: A bottom sheet titled Updates is open with a count of open updates and one grouped list of auto agent rows.

steps.name: A row opens the report
steps.goal: Tap the Triage new bug reports row in the Updates sheet.
steps.done: The Updates sheet is closed and the Triage new bug reports agent report is open.
